_about: AUTHORED (T78, audit N20). Level gauges the tide or a tidal river's backwater moves, which the HYDAT record does not already say are tidal (pipeline/gauges/consume/tidal.py reads the record's STN_REMARKS for that: 08MH024 Fraser River at Mission and 08MH126 Fraser River at Port Mann come from there). Each row carries why. The bundle writes gauge.tidal = 1 for the union; the app says one sentence in the Level view. Add a station here only with a reason a reader could check.

stations.08MH028: Fraser River at Steveston: the Fraser estuary at the river mouth, below Mission (the tidal reach of the lower Fraser; own-gauge REPORT 2026-10-22).
stations.08MH032: North Arm Fraser River at Vancouver: the Fraser estuary's North Arm, below Mission (the tidal reach of the lower Fraser).
stations.08MH035: Pitt River near Port Coquitlam: owner 2026-10-22, "Port Coquitlam is tidal, with Fraser backwater" (decisions.md, a water's own gauge comes first).
stations.08MH044: Fraser River at Whonock: between Mission (HYDAT: tidal effects) and Port Mann (HYDAT: subject to tidal effect) on the lower Fraser; own-gauge REPORT 2026-10-22 names it a tidal level gauge.
stations.08MH053: Fraser River at Deas Island Tunnel: the Fraser estuary's main arm, below Mission (the tidal reach of the lower Fraser).
